title: Toast placement with a right drawer on windows under ~1100px: the fallback clears only the drawer chrome, so the create-success toast covers the record header's 编辑 / ⋯ for its whole life (residual of objectui#11685)
body:
Filing gate **① a reproduced UX defect** (class a, public door: creating a record). `reach:` local stack, objectui pin `6f629a7`, 1024×768 viewport, zh-CN, 2026-10-27. After 新建 → 创建 on a record form, the record drawer opens (width 720) and the success toast 「家装项目创建成功」 sits at x 644–1000, y 69–123 for its whole life. That **covers the record's 「编辑」 button** (rect 858–934 × 93–129) and the ⋯ menu beside it. Measured with `elementFromPoint`: the toast is topmost (z-index 999999999).

Batch-of: 2 · 2026-10-27 follow-up to the 2026-10-25 desktop E2E (doubtful items re-measured). Filed at the maintainer's request: 「必要的合理的建议都可以立卡」 / 「有疑点的进一步确认」.

**Business reason.** Right after creating a record, the next thing a user does is often fix something: they reach for 编辑. objectui#11685 set out to keep the toast off "the record's own header with its Approve-style actions under it". On any window narrower than about 1,100 px (small laptops, split screens, a browser beside a chat app), it still lands there for ~4 s.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:ui` seat: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/ConsoleToaster.tsx` (objectui was folded into this repository; objectstack#25854).

## Where (measured on objectui pin `6f629a7`, which includes objectui#11685's fix `267b539f`; unchanged on objectstack `main` at `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/ConsoleToaster.tsx:97-101`)
- `ConsoleToaster.tsx:99-101`: `fitsBeside = innerWidth − drawerWidth ≥ TOAST_WIDTH + 2·gap`. Here 1024 − 720 = 304 < 356, so the fallback `{ top: headerBottom + VIEWPORT_GAP }` applies.
- `headerBottom` (:97) is the dialog's top-level block holding the `aria-labelledby` title: the drawer **chrome** (「家装项目 / 家装项目 的记录详情浮层。」), bottom = 45 px. The record header with 编辑 / ⋯ is below it (93–129), so the fallback clears the chrome and lands on the actions. That is the case the module comment says it prevents.

## Expected
In the fallback, the toast clears the record header's action row too. For example: measure to the bottom of the first actions row inside the dialog, or place the toast at the bottom-right of the drawer, away from both. Add a test at a 1024 px window.

## Dedupe
`gh api search/issues`, incl. closed, `toast drawer`: objectui 34 (0 open), objectstack 33 (QA runs / sweep).
- objectui#11685 (closed; fix `267b539f` in this pin, `compare 267b539f...6f629a7310` = ahead) is the same goal. This is the narrow-window residual its fallback does not cover.
- objectui#11723 (closed) is toast clickability under an open dialog, which is different.
